name: Paper_Mind
singlePurpose: Help users save and retrieve their personal research-paper library through remembered concepts, existing tags and notes. Page clipping, publication metadata, reading progress and optional AI support that same paper-library workflow.

remoteCode.explanation: All extension JavaScript, HTML and CSS is bundled in the uploaded Manifest V3 package. Network responses provide content, metadata or model text/JSON, not executable extension code. Responses are parsed as data. The optional, separately installed local bridge invokes supported installed CLI programs with fixed operations; it does not download or inject executable code into the extension.

zh_CN.shortDescription: 用脑海中的概念和标签找回读过的论文。一篇论文、多重标签、一句话记忆；本地管理，AI 可选。

en.shortDescription: Find saved papers through the concepts you remember. Multiple tags, one-line memories, local library and optional AI.

ownerFieldsToComplete: Developer identity, verified account contact email and any required business/trader declarations
Distribution countries/regions and public or unlisted visibility
Optional localized YouTube video URLs after the owner uploads the existing videos
Final privacy certifications in the developer dashboard
